summary: Iteration 2 focused on the newly-added bimonthly billing feature and Emergent badge removal. 13/13 new billing pytest cases pass. 21/21 Playwright UI checks pass (billing card on Dashboard, /billing page, close-bill dialog, past-cycle delete, badge absent on all 7 pages). DB left with 45-day seed + one open cycle and owner_name restored to 'GeeBin A R'.

issues: Repeated Chrome Canvas2D console warning: 'Multiple readback operations using getImageData are faster with the willReadFrequently attribute set to true.' Cosmetic; already noted in iteration_1 action items.

action_items: Optional: pass willReadFrequently:true on chart canvases (still open from iteration_1).

Test infra: /app/backend/pytest.ini uses '-n 2 --dist loadscope' which parallelizes across test files. backend_test.py and test_billing.py both mutate shared DB state (seed/wipe) so running both files together in parallel causes flakes. Each file passes 100% when run individually. Consider adding a session-scoped DB lock or renaming to force single scope if a combined run is desired.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py `_ensure_open_cycle`: when readings collection is empty the fresh cycle uses date.today() UTC-naive - fine, but if server timezone differs from client TZ this may produce off-by-one. Consider making cycle date derivation explicit about timezone.

server.py `update_cycle` only recomputes closing_* when payload.end_date AND cycle is already closed. If a user shifts start_date on an already-closed cycle without touching end_date, closing_* becomes stale. Consider always recomputing for closed cycles when any date field changes.
server.py `_cycle_totals` returns 'latest_reading_date' but the field is not used anywhere in Dashboard/Billing responses - dead field.

server.py `close_current_bill` starts next cycle at end_date+1 even if there is a reading dated later than end_date+1 (the new cycle then already includes that reading). This is arguably correct behavior but should be documented.
Billing.jsx `close-bill-cancel-btn` inside DialogFooter has data-testid but review request mentions only date/notes/confirm - no bug, just extra.

Dashboard.jsx: `BillingStatusCard` reads `billing.current` unconditionally after the parent's `kpis.billing?.current` guard - safe, but the inner component could still crash if `billing` is passed but `current` is null. Minor defensive coding suggestion.
Frontend: `Billing.jsx` reloads the whole overview after every close/delete via load(); acceptable for MVP but a targeted state update would be cleaner.

success_rate.backend: 100% (13/13 new billing tests, iteration_1 regression 16/16 still passes standalone)

seed_data_creation: Final state: PUT /api/settings owner_name='GeeBin A R'; POST /api/seed?days=45 -> 45 readings, single open cycle starting 2026-05-26 (45 days back), 0 past cycles.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New billing regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_billing.py (TestBillingCycles class, tests 01-13). It ends with POST /api/seed?days=45. Run it in isolation (pytest backend/tests/test_billing.py) to avoid the xdist/DB collision with backend_test.py. Emergent badge script removed from public/index.html - verified count==0 on dashboard, billing, history, reports, analytics, settings, backup. Dashboard shows BillingStatusCard when kpis.billing.current exists.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found in the feature under test.
